Evidence 2026-11-03 (session a85e3cd3), worktree at 2e8e8051796 plus the test change:
- Root cause: the test both ignored the store compact result AND never compacted. The 2-event ticket is under the default threshold (10) and inside the 1800 s horizon, so the command printed 'below threshold (2 <= 10) — skipping compaction' with exit 0 and left both event files live.
- Red (no-op): strengthened assertions without --threshold=0 --horizon=0 FAILED on 'store compact wrote no SNAPSHOT'.
- Red (seeded failure): scratch copies (never committed) appending an unknown argument --seeded-failure, which compact_cli rejects with exit 1. Old test body: PASSED (the bug). New test body: FAILED with 'store compact failed (exit 1)'.
- Green: pytest tests/unit/reconciler/apply/test_peer_confirmations_store.py -> 20 passed. make lint exit 0, make typecheck exit 0, make import-convention exit 0.
- Other sites: AST scan of tests for discarded compact/fsck results. rebar.compact() raises on failure; fsck --repair sites in test_concurrency_regression assert the repair effect. 4 tests confirmed vacuous under a no-op-returning-1 compact_all_cli plugin, filed as soldierly-arbitrary-hackee (discovered_from).
